description: The chart presents human evaluation outcomes for three models, illustrating the distribution of results across three categories (Win, Tie, Lose) using horizontal stacked bars. The category axis is the vertical (y) axis, listing the models in the displayed order from top to bottom as Claude3.5, GPT4o, and Doubao, with no additional y-axis label shown. The value axis is the horizontal (x) axis, shown on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.2 intervals; this axis represents proportions corresponding to the stacked segment widths, while the segment annotations provide percentages. Each model’s bar is divided into three colored segments according to the legend: Win (pink), Tie (light blue), and Lose (light green). For Claude3.5, the stacked bar shows 32.0% Win (pink) followed by 44.0% Tie (light blue) and 24.0% Lose (light green). For GPT4o, the bar shows 56.0% Win (pink), 18.0% Tie (light blue), and 26.0% Lose (light green). For Doubao, the bar shows 42.0% Win (pink), 36.0% Tie (light blue), and 22.0% Lose (light green). The segments are arranged left-to-right in the consistent order Win, then Tie, then Lose, and each segment contains a centered percentage label; no bars appear specially highlighted beyond these internal annotations and the color legend.
